Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649959 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures to get canonical_smiles. Join activities to assays and filter by assay chembl_id. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
